overview_description.description:
Sanitation and Health Rights in India (SHRI)  fights alongside communities to end open defecation as a key step in an ongoing struggle for health equity and social and economic justice.

The company has built a toilet that converts poop into methane gas that powers a water filtration system that creates clean drinking water. SHRI then sells the water in the local community to make the whole system sustainable. Source: [TechCrunch](http://techcrunch.com/2016/03/23/y-combinator-winter-2016/)

product.name: Operating System for Sanitation Facilities
product.description: A system that manages daily operations of community and institutional sanitation facilities, including staffing, cleaning, maintenance, and supply management to ensure continuous service delivery.

product.name: Monitoring System for Sanitation Facilities
product.description: A digital system that tracks usage, quality, and accessibility of sanitation facilities through automated counters and staff-reported data to support facility performance management.
